remarks: Welcome to 100 Hope street Unit 8, this updated tri-level condo offers over 1,800 square feet of living space with 2 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a layout designed for today's lifestyle. Modern finishes, vaulted ceilings, and abundant natural light make this home both stylish and comfortable. The main level features an airy living room anchored by a dramatic stone fireplace wall. Large sliders open to a private balcony, blending indoor and outdoor living and creating the perfect spot to relax or entertain. Just above, the dining area overlooks the living space, offering a contemporary feel and effortless flow. The kitchen boasts white cabinetry, a subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances, combining clean design with everyday functionality. Upstairs, the vaulted-ceiling primary suite is complete with a private deck, spacious closet, and updated en-suite bathroom. A second bedroom, also with vaulted ceilings, is served by a stylish full bath down the hall-perfect for guests, family, or a home office. The finished lower level expands the living space with a flexible family room, office nook, and another full bathroom. This area can easily serve as a guest suite, gym, or playroom, offering versatility to meet changing needs.
